note: The fuzz input is treated as an HTTP request buffer and routed into proxy parsing when the request allows it.
A PROXY-prefixed buffer is dispatched to the v1 parser, which tokenizes the same attacker-controlled bytes in place.
The first split produces the source-address field pointer from the input line.
The parser assumes the previous split yielded a non-NULL field; the missing safety obligation is that src_addr must still point to a space-delimited token before splitting again.
When dst_addr is NULL, the next call enters strsep_char with a NULL strp and crashes on the strchr dereference path.
